title: fix: keep caret, caret-color and caret-shape in source order
author: oddharsh
summary: FallbackHandler writes a later caret-color/caret back into the earlier slot, which reorders interleaved caret and caret-color/caret-shape declarations and changes which one wins. The PR forgets the other slot when a related property is seen, keeping source order at the cost of not deduplicating the earlier declaration. Small, plausible correctness fix; rare usage pattern, hence low priority.
evidence: Master: `.a{caret-color:red;caret:auto;caret-color:blue}` -> `.a{caret-color:#00f;caret:auto}` (blue now overridden by caret:auto, so caret color becomes auto: wrong). `.b{caret:red;caret-color:blue;caret:green}` -> `.b{caret:green;caret-color:#00f}` (blue wins instead of green). Only PR for #1362; no comments or reviews. Reviewer should check the unparsed/var() paths and whether the handler needs similar logic for other shorthand/longhand pairs it manages.
